title: A Mansuba Finish
setup: A shatranj-style problem: rook and knight against a king in the corner, and Black has nothing but pawn shuffles.
hint: Do not check yet. The knight already owns g8 and h7, so ask which rank the rook needs before the check is worth giving.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the **Arabian mate** from the oldest problem collections: a rook beside the king in the corner, a knight guarding the rook.

The rook cannot give it from c1. {{Rc7}} is quiet: the rook takes the seventh rank, the knight already covers g8, and the king has no square left. Black can only push a pawn, {{b4}} or any other, and {{Rh7#}} follows, the knight guarding h7.

Check first with {{Rc8+}} and the king slips out to g7. Build the net, then check.
